I am 65 years old, finished middle school, and I have farmed these 2 mu in Quzhou for 45 years. It is just me now, so I do all the work myself. I cannot afford to waste money, but a bad harvest would be a disaster, so I would rather use a bit too much fertilizer than too little. I watch what my neighbors do, and I stick with what worked last year.

For wheat this year, I will rotary till the land in October and sow Jimai 22, about 15 kg of seed per mu. I will buy one 50-kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer and spread it on my 2 mu before sowing, so that is 25 kg per mu. When the wheat turns green in March, I will topdress with urea, about 15 kg per mu. I will irrigate three times from my well: once before winter freeze-up, once in spring when the wheat starts growing fast, and once at grain filling if it stays dry. I will spray herbicide once after sowing, and fungicide once in spring for the rust. Most years that is two sprayings total. I expect about 500 kg per mu if the weather is normal.

After I harvest the wheat in June, I will sow Denghai 605 hybrid maize right away with no-tillage, the seeding machine drills straight into the stubble. I will use about 2 kg seed per mu. I will put down another 50-kg bag of compound fertilizer, 25 kg per mu, and at the big trumpet leaf stage I will topdress with about 20 kg urea per mu. I will irrigate twice: once right after sowing, and once at flowering in August. For chemicals, I will spray herbicide once, insecticide once for the corn borers, and fungicide once if the summer is humid, so three applications. I expect about 550 kg per mu.

I do not change much from year to year. My neighbor Lao Wang has similar land and does about the same, and his crops always look fine.
